description: Generates an uneven bricks pattern in rows.

inputs.description: A map that affects the Mortar parameter
inputs.name: mortar_map

inputs.description: A map that affects the Bevel parameter
inputs.name: bevel_map

inputs.description: A map that affects the Round parameter
inputs.name: round_map

name: Uneven Bricks 2

outputs.description: A grayscale image that shows the bricks pattern
outputs.label: Bricks pattern

outputs.description: An output that should be plugged into a Fill companion node
outputs.label: Brick Fill

outputs.description: An output that should be plugged into a Fill companion node
outputs.label: Corner Fill

parameters.description: The number of rows of a pattern
parameters.label: Rows
parameters.name: rows

parameters.description: The number of iterations of the brick split operation
parameters.label: Iterations
parameters.name: iterations

parameters.description: The minimum size of a brick
parameters.label: Min size
parameters.name: min_size

parameters.description: The width of the space between bricks
parameters.label: Mortar
parameters.name: mortar

parameters.description: The width of the edge of each brick
parameters.label: Bevel
parameters.name: bevel

parameters.description: The radius of the round corners of bricks
parameters.label: Round
parameters.name: round

parameters.description: The size of the corner part of each brick (only used by the Corner UV output)
parameters.label: Corner
parameters.name: corner
